patthana22.5:1.1: dhammo kusalassa sappaccayassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo cha, (saṅkhataṃ sappaccaya sadisaṃ.)
patthana22.5:2.1: na kusalaṃ na sanidassanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato sanidassano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā cha,
patthana22.5:3.1: na kusalo na anidassano dhammo kusalassa anidassanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. nava pañhā kātabbā.
patthana22.5:4.1: na kusalaṃ na sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā cha.
patthana22.5:5.1: na kusalaṃ na appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato appaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. kusalaṃ rūpiṃ
patthana22.5:6.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato rūpī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā cha.
patthana22.5:7.1: na kusalaṃ na arūpiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato arūpī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi,
patthana22.5:8.1: na kusalaṃ na lokiyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato lokiyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā pañca,
patthana22.5:9.1: na kusalaṃ na lokuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo lokuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (abyākato lokuttaro dhammo-. cha pañhā kātabbā.)
patthana22.5:10.1: na kusalaṃ na kenaciviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo kenaciviññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā aṭṭhārasa.
patthana22.5:11.1: na kusalaṃ na kenaciviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo kenaciviññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā aṭṭhārasa. na kusalaṃ no āsavaṃ
